concepts.title: Polynomial ring modulo $y^r + 1$

symbols.name: record length

concepts.gloss: Encoding polynomial coefficients, including negative ones, as one large integer by fixed-width blocks, so that polynomial multiplication becomes integer multiplication.

concepts.name: Subspace labels

concepts.name: Linear networks and frames
concepts.gloss: A fixed linear network that exchanges two banks of values while restoring scratch values, in which each vertex carries an invertible operator called its frame.

evidence.quote: Each procedure arises from its own fixed linear network that exchanges two banks of values

concepts.name: Subset-intersection network
concepts.gloss: A linear network on the three-element subsets of a ground set, whose wires carry scalars and whose gates combine them by intersection size, so that it swaps two banks while cancelling arbitrary scratch values.

evidence.quote: The construction uses three-element subsets: gather and scatter create coefficients

concepts.name: Address-field interchange
concepts.gloss: A tape procedure that swaps two disjoint contiguous address fields of an array in time that grows like a power of the field width, rather than linearly.

evidence.quote: The first procedure interchanges two disjoint contiguous address fields of u bits in an array

concepts.name: Address shear
concepts.gloss: The map that updates two address fields H, D to H + D, D, which is implemented by a small number of field interchanges.

evidence.quote: that endpoint operator is an address shear

concepts.name: Rank-saving recursion
concepts.gloss: The recursion in which each call splits into s smaller calls on streams of 1/W of the volume, where s < W m, so that the cost grows by the strictly smaller factor s/W per level.

evidence.quote: the total number s of smaller calls satisfies s < W m

concepts.name: Gaussian dyadics
concepts.gloss: Complex numbers whose real and imaginary parts are integers divided by a power of two, with the Gaussian integer part also an integer.

evidence.quote: Intermediate values are exact Gaussian dyadics

concepts.name: Complex phase network
concepts.gloss: A subset-intersection network whose frame change on each edge is a product of two-point kernels aI + bX on Gaussian dyadic values.

evidence.quote: The complex phase network of Proposition 8

concepts.name: Simultaneous butterfly layer
concepts.gloss: The tensor product of the two-point map H0 applied to several selected address bits at once, computed exactly in one pass rather than one axis at a time.

evidence.quote: a common butterfly layer on several axes

concepts.name: Packed selected-bit addition
concepts.gloss: An operation that adds one selected bit position across several address chunks at once, using cyclic shifts and a small deterministic correction for exceptional addresses.

evidence.quote: Packed selected-bit addition on one rectangle

concepts.name: Guard-width bound
concepts.gloss: An explicit number of extra fractional and integer bits that makes every intermediate coefficient of a butterfly layer exact, so that a single final truncation suffices.

evidence.quote: An explicit guard-width bound

concepts.name: Transform layout
concepts.gloss: A permutation of address bits that places the selected bits of all participating axes at a common offset in consecutive chunks, so that a simultaneous butterfly layer applies to each transform round.

evidence.quote: A layout on which the parallel layers apply

concepts.name: Prime source lengths
concepts.gloss: Distinct odd primes chosen close to the powers of two that are the padded axis lengths, so that their product fills a fixed fraction of the padded box.

evidence.quote: The distinct prime lengths si must be close to the powers of two ti

concepts.name: Transform identity with retained permutations
concepts.gloss: The Gaussian resampling identity in which the source and target coordinate permutations are kept as part of the formula, so that they cancel across a convolution instead of being executed as sorts.

evidence.quote: We retain both permutations in the transform formula

concepts.name: Carry propagation
concepts.gloss: Converting the recovered integer radix-digit coefficients into a binary string by adding each coefficient to a carry from the previous position.

evidence.quote: Propagate radix-2b carries in increasing coefficient order

concepts.name: Exact coefficient recovery
concepts.gloss: The error analysis showing that the computed convolution coefficients are within a half of their true integer values, so rounding recovers them exactly.

evidence.quote: proves that the recovered coefficient error is strictly below 1/2

concepts.name: Vector spaces, subspaces, bases and dimension
concepts.gloss: A set closed under addition and scalar multiplication over a field, whose subspaces, bases and dimension are the usual notions of linear algebra.

concepts.name: Rank of a matrix
concepts.gloss: The number of linearly independent rows or columns of a matrix, equal to the dimension of its column space.

concepts.name: Invertible matrices and inverses
concepts.gloss: A square matrix M is invertible when some matrix M^-1 satisfies M M^-1 = I, and then M represents a bijective linear map.

concepts.name: Gaussian elimination and triangular matrices
concepts.gloss: Row reduction by elementary row operations, which puts a matrix in echelon form, and matrices whose entries vanish on one side of the diagonal.

concepts.name: Eigenvalues and diagonalization
concepts.gloss: A scalar lambda is an eigenvalue of a matrix A when Av = lambda v for some nonzero vector v, and a matrix is diagonalizable when it is similar to a diagonal matrix.

concepts.name: Dot product, orthogonal complement and projection
concepts.gloss: The dot product of two vectors, the set of vectors orthogonal to every vector of a subspace, and the linear map that projects onto a subspace along a complementary subspace.

concepts.name: Permutations and permutation matrices
concepts.gloss: A permutation is a bijection of a finite index set to itself, and its permutation matrix is the 0-1 matrix that moves coordinates accordingly.

concepts.name: Modular arithmetic
concepts.gloss: Integers a and b are congruent modulo q when q divides a minus b, and arithmetic on the residue classes Z/qZ is well defined.

concepts.name: Greatest common divisor and coprimality
concepts.gloss: The greatest common divisor of two integers is the largest integer dividing both, computable by Euclid's algorithm, and two integers are coprime when their gcd is 1.

concepts.name: Prime numbers
concepts.gloss: A prime is an integer greater than 1 whose only positive divisors are 1 and itself, and every integer greater than 1 factors uniquely into primes.

concepts.name: Chinese remainder theorem
aliases: Chinese remainder theorem for coprime moduli
concepts.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli q_1, ..., q_k, the system of congruences x = a_i modulo q_i has a unique solution modulo their product.

concepts.name: Binary field GF(2)
concepts.gloss: The field with two elements 0 and 1, in which addition is exclusive or (XOR) and multiplication is AND.

concepts.name: Hamming weight
concepts.gloss: The Hamming weight of a binary vector is its number of entries equal to 1.

concepts.name: Indicator vector of a set
concepts.gloss: The 0-1 vector of a finite set with entry 1 exactly at the elements of the set, given a fixed ordering of the ground set.

concepts.name: Binomial coefficients
concepts.gloss: The binomial coefficient C(n, k) is the number of k-element subsets of an n-element set.

concepts.name: Positional and mixed-radix notation
concepts.gloss: A representation of an integer as digits whose place values are powers of a fixed radix, or of a sequence of radices in the mixed-radix case.

concepts.name: Dyadic rationals
concepts.gloss: Rational numbers whose denominator is a power of two, equivalently the numbers with finitely many binary digits after the point.

concepts.name: Gaussian integers
concepts.gloss: The complex numbers a + bi with integers a and b, which form a ring under complex addition and multiplication.

concepts.name: Roots of unity
concepts.gloss: A complex number z is an nth root of unity when z^n = 1, and a primitive nth root has order exactly n, so its powers give all nth roots of unity.

concepts.name: Mathematical induction
concepts.gloss: A proof method that establishes a statement for every integer from a base case and a proof that each case implies the next.

concepts.name: Recurrence relations and geometric sums
concepts.gloss: An equation that defines a sequence in terms of its earlier terms, solved by unrolling it, together with the geometric sum of powers of a fixed ratio.

concepts.name: Iterated logarithm
concepts.gloss: The function log* n is the number of times the base-2 logarithm must be applied to n before the result is at most 1.

concepts.name: Logarithms, floor and ceiling
concepts.gloss: The base-2 logarithm, written lg n or log2 n, with the floor and ceiling functions that round it to integers.

concepts.name: Union bound
concepts.gloss: The probability that at least one of finitely many events occurs is at most the sum of the probabilities of the events.

concepts.name: Karatsuba multiplication
concepts.gloss: The divide-and-conquer multiplication of two n-bit integers that splits each into halves and uses three half-size products, running in O(n^1.585) time.

background: This reader has an undergraduate computer science degree: discrete mathematics (modular arithmetic, gcd and primes, binomial counting, induction), linear algebra over the reals and small fields (subspaces, rank, elimination, eigenvalues, dot-product orthogonal complements and projections), and algorithms (divide-and-conquer recurrences, Karatsuba multiplication, and the DFT and cyclic convolution as used for FFT-based polynomial multiplication). Complex numbers are known as far as roots of unity and Gaussian integers, Turing machines are known with multiple tapes, and basic probability reaches the union bound. Tensor products, bilinear forms beyond the dot product, quotient rings and the sources' network and address constructions are not part of this background.
